svg.title: Work route
svg.desc: 4 roles from 2016 to 2026, spaced by date on one axis: first commit, 2016-08; JP Morgan, 2019-07 .. 2020-12 (1y 6mo); Apple, 2020-12 .. 2022-01 (1y 2mo); Twilio, 2022-01 .. 2026-07 (4y 7mo); Machinify, 2026-07 .. now (3mo).
